META_TITLE: Budget App Without Bank Sync (No Plaid, No Login) — FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin is a budget app with no bank sync — no Plaid, no bank credentials. Add transactions manually or by CSV. Your data is stored in your FincWin account. Free.
OG_DESCRIPTION: A budget app that needs no bank sync. No Plaid, no login — manual or CSV entry. Free to start.
HERO_HEADLINE: Budget without handing over your bank login
HERO_SUBHEAD: No Plaid, no credentials, no third-party connection. Add transactions manually or import a CSV — your bank never enters the picture.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Bank sync means trusting a middleman with your login
PROBLEM_BODY:
Most budget apps connect through services like Plaid, which need your banking credentials and route your transaction data through their servers. For a lot of people that's a hard no.

FincWin doesn't sync with your bank at all. You stay in control of what goes in — by hand or by CSV — and your records are stored in your FincWin account, not passed through a bank-data aggregator.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓No bank credentials — ever. No Plaid, no aggregator.
  • ✓Manual or CSV entry — add what you want, when you want.
  • ✓Your records, isolated to your household — export or delete your data any time.
  • ✓Full budgeting — envelopes, goals, loans, analytics.
COMPARISON_TABLE: Needs bank loginNoYes (via Plaid etc.) Bank data routed through an aggregatorNoYes Manual & CSV entryYesSometimes
FAQ_ITEMS:
How do transactions get in without bank sync?

You add them manually in seconds, or import a CSV exported from your bank. FincWin never needs your login.

Is CSV import free?

CSV import is a Pro feature ($39/year or $149 lifetime). Manual entry is free forever.

Where is my data stored?

Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time. You can also save a backup copy to your own Google Drive.
